commands:
  {show,resolve,history,merge,split,retire,restore,reclassify}
    show                show an object's state and current holdings
    resolve             resolve a KN ID to its terminal IDs

    restore             restore a retired object without a successor
    reclassify          retire the object and mint a successor of a different

assign current holdings to two or more successors

  --performed-at PERFORMED_AT

  --evidence EVIDENCE   reference to supporting evidence
